name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Systems & Asset Governance | Taxonomy, Naming Standards, E-commerce & Image SEO
summary: Marketing operations builder with 15+ years across e-commerce, SaaS, and agency roles, specializing in the systems behind the content: taxonomy, naming and tagging standards, and workflows that let teams find the right approved thing without asking. Built e-commerce storefronts for established retail brands at Wix, defined the CRM field standards for onboarding workflows while leading a 20-person team, and runs technical SEO (site crawls, schema, on-page fixes inside client CMS platforms) at Solenzo. Connects systems with Zapier, Make, and n8n to cut manual downloading, renaming, and re-uploading. Has worked in shared file and asset libraries (Dropbox, Google Drive) in every role, and trains non-technical users until the system sticks. Denver metro based, ready for hybrid in Broomfield.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Build reusable marketing asset templates and messaging frameworks from a shared base, adapting them to each client's brand and vertical instead of recreating assets from scratch.
Set up and maintain Google Business Profile listings for every client, including categories, services, photos, and posts, keeping approved imagery current across listings.
Run technical SEO audits with Screaming Frog, including URL structure, schema and structured data, and on-page fixes implemented directly inside client CMS platforms.
Design tagging systems, naming conventions, lifecycle stages, and data-hygiene rules in GoHighLevel and HubSpot so records stay searchable and clean across concurrent clients.
Automate handoffs between CRMs, CMS platforms, and marketing tools in Zapier, Make, and n8n, removing repeated manual steps from each workflow.
Build and edit web pages directly in HTML/CSS, and install Google Tag Manager and GA4 on every site launched.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced landing pages, email sequences, and paid-campaign assets across channels with their own specs and approval rules, coordinating execution across internal creative and media teams.
Ran LinkedIn ad campaigns with A/B-tested creative, and reported results to multi-stakeholder clients.

Built automated training sequences that got partners using the platform correctly without hand-holding.
